title: ReBlade: The Death Spiral Demo
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#938, 2026-11-03), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.24, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5: a 15 to 20 minute session. Resolution changes misbehaved until the game's settings were reset to their defaults, then about 17 fps on low settings. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on an M1 with D3DMetal, at about 17 fps on low settings, once the game's settings are back at their defaults.

knownIssues.symptom: Resolution changes in the game misbehave (a click made the picture four times bigger, 1920x1080 came out squished, and once 800x600 was the largest size offered)
knownIssues.fix: reset the game's settings to their defaults, which cleared it for the reporter
